name: GMR Production Smoke Tests
description: Validates critical user flows against the live GMR platform. Runs every 8 hours as a Kubernetes CronJob.

flows.title: Login page renders
flows.description: Navigates to /login and verifies the email, password, and submit fields are visible.

flows.title: Email/password login
flows.description: Logs in with test credentials and verifies redirect to home page with navigation visible.
steps: Fill email and password fields with test credentials

flows.title: Session persists in header
flows.description: After login, the sign-out button appears in the header confirming an active session.

flows.title: Entity search returns results
flows.description: Searches for 'Apple' on the landing page and verifies AAPL appears in the results.
steps: Wait for result cards to appear

flows.title: Company profile loads
flows.description: Opens the Apple Inc fundamentals page and verifies financial data panel renders.

flows.title: Graph Explorer renders (WebGL)
flows.description: Opens the Apple graph explorer and verifies the Sigma.js WebGL canvas initializes.
steps: Wait for graph container, .ge-canvas, or canvas element (timeout 15s)

flows.title: Create report
flows.description: Creates a new report via the community API and verifies the response contains a valid ID and title.
steps: Assert response contains id and matching title

flows.title: Add section to report
flows.description: Adds an HTML section to the report and verifies the content is stored correctly.
steps: Assert response contains the content text

flows.title: Report persists
flows.description: Fetches the report by ID and verifies title and sections survived across requests.
steps: Assert at least 1 section exists with correct content

flows.title: Basic query response
flows.description: Sends a simple question to the AI assistant and verifies it returns a meaningful response.
steps: POST /capi/assist/chat with a question about Apple's ticker
Assert response content is longer than 10 characters

flows.title: Report editing via propose_edit
flows.description: Asks the AI assistant to add a section to the report. Validates it attempts to use the propose_edit MCP tool to generate structured edit actions.
steps: POST /capi/assist/chat asking to add a section titled 'Apple Overview'
Pass full report context (id, title, sections) so the assistant can propose edits
Assert response contains either a structured suggestion or acknowledges the edit

flows.title: MCP graph tool usage
flows.description: Asks the AI assistant a question that specifically requires the MCP search_entities tool to answer. Validates it retrieves live data from the GMR graph rather than relying on general knowledge.
steps: POST /capi/assist/chat asking to search for 'Apple' in the graph and report what data exists
Assert tool_calls_made > 0 or response references specific graph data (AAPL, contracts, relationships)

flows.title: Delete test report
flows.description: Deletes the smoke test report and verifies it no longer appears in the report listing.
steps: GET /capi/reports and assert the report ID is not in the list
